title: Started building for a living
description: First engineering job at SquadRun out of the 91springboard coworking space. Founded Unstudious, an EdTech venture that drew attention from Matrix Partners and Tracxn.

title: Paytm
description: Software engineer on the seller platform during India's fintech surge, then promoted to growth engineering — deep-linking and price comparison at scale.

title: Went independent
description: Left Paytm to contract across React, React Native, and early blockchain work for teams in the US and Europe.

title: Pei and Bitcharge v1
description: Began a four-year run building a US consumer fintech at Pei. On the side, launched Bitcharge — 195 people used it to accept crypto payments.

title: Founded Droidsize
description: Registered Droidsize Technologies with Neeraj Kumar — the product studio where most of my work now lives.

title: Entered the Polkadot ecosystem
description: First Kusama treasury grants and the beginning of a long arc in Web3 developer tooling.

title: Flex, then the fork in the road
description: Joined Flex after Pei's acquihire. When the role ended, chose building companies over returning to employment.

title: Founded Charge23 Labs
description: Incorporated with my wife Evisha to build Chargespot — EV charging for India. DPIIT-recognised, incubated at AIC Sangam.

title: Web3 Foundation grant
description: Relaycode's W3F grant application merged — the redemption arc for earlier unfinished treasury work.

title: The AI-agents shift
description: Rebuilt my entire workflow around AI agents. Output changed step-function: Domain Collective shipped, Merry Magic Mail launched on Product Hunt.

title: Coming out of hiding
description: Relaycode Milestone 2 delivered. Droidsize relaunched with a site worthy of its products. This portfolio rebuilt to tell the story properly.
